messages.subject: Sourcing R Scripts in Shiny
parts:
Hi All,

I'm trying to source an R script when a certain option from my dropbox is selected. How would I go about doing that? An example:


server <- function(input, output) {


output$Box1 = renderUI(selectizeInput("type", "Choose Calculator Type:", choices = c('', 'a','b','c'),options = list(placeholder = "Choose One")))

 

 if(input$type == 'c') source("D:/OneDrive for Business/2016 Base  Year/Region03/Com_Ind_2016/Calcv1_DevelopmentLand.R")

}


I know this method isn't correct, I just wanted to give an example to work off of.


Thanks,
